hero.name: Yuki Iwahashi
hero.title: AI Computing Engineer
hero.description: Specializing in processor design, computer architecture, and AI model optimization. Building the future of intelligent computing.

about.title: About Me
about.description: I am a researcher and engineer specializing in AI computing, with deep expertise in processor design, computer architecture, and AI/ML model development. My work focuses on bridging the gap between hardware and software to enable the next generation of intelligent systems.

items.title: RISC-V 32I Processor Design
items.description: Designed a RISC-V32I processor core with 5 stages of pipeline and 32 registers.

items.title: RISC-V 64IMA Processor Design with xv6
items.description: Designed a RISC-V64IMA processor core with 5 stages of pipeline and 32 registers. The processor is capable of running the xv6 operating system.

items.title: self deeplearning framework(dezero)
items.description: Developed a self-made deeplearning framework with only numpy. The framework is capable of training and inference of deep learning models.

items.title: 8-bit CPU (Built with Electronic Circuits)
items.description: Designed and built an 8-bit CPU from scratch using electronic circuits. Gained hands-on understanding of fundamental computer architecture principles.

timeline.title: Internship at Marubeni Degital Experts
timeline.description: Analysis of power generation data from solar power plants in Mexico. Proposing cleaning schedules for each location based on the analysis data.

timeline.title: Internship at Fixstars
timeline.description: Research on Vision Language Model(Ovis2, InternVL) to run on edge devices(drone). Intended for use in locating people lost in snowy mountains.

timeline.title: Belonging to Research Laboratory
timeline.description: Research focus on AI computing. Submitting papers to top conferences such as NeurIPS, ISSCC, HPCA, and ISCA.

timeline.title: B.S. in Information and Communications Engineering
